requirement: Research considered by Nature Health is judged on originality, timeliness, and impact on health policy and practice; observational and environmental-health research are named as in scope.
evidence_to_prove: Final fit assessment and cover-letter rationale that establish broad environmental-health and policy/practice relevance without claiming an unmeasured health effect.
current_project_status: GATE: named scope fit is plausible, but policy/practice impact without a health outcome is not established.
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: The page does not state that every paper must measure a health outcome, but its health-policy/practice criterion makes an exposure-only paper editorially risky.

requirement: Nature Health states that it requires meaningful engagement with research participants and their communities.
evidence_to_prove: Factual involvement statement, author confirmation, and explicit treatment of the absence of formal engagement in the journal-fit assessment.
current_project_status: GATE: no formal participant/community engagement is documented beyond participation and site collaboration.
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: No dedicated reporting form, section, or retrospective exception is specified; a negative statement does not itself satisfy the stated requirement.

requirement: Article abstract is unreferenced and no longer than 150 words.

requirement: Article main text is no longer than 4000 words, excluding abstract, Methods, references, and figure legends.
evidence_to_prove: Section-aware word-count report from the authoritative source and final DOCX.
current_project_status: NOT_VERIFIED
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: The Content Types page contains an editorial placeholder; recheck the limit immediately before submission.

requirement: An Article has no more than six combined main display items, figures and tables.
evidence_to_prove: Final display manifest showing the combined main figure/table count.
current_project_status: NOT_VERIFIED
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: The limit is combined, not six figures plus six tables.

requirement: The introduction has no heading; Results and Methods use topical subheadings; Discussion has no subheadings.

current_project_status: NOT_VERIFIED
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: The journal labels this a guideline rather than a hard maximum.

requirement: Submission should be accessible to non-specialists; jargon and abbreviations should be minimized or defined, and title and abstract should be intelligible to any scientist.
evidence_to_prove: Final editorial review and terminology/abbreviation audit.
current_project_status: PARTIAL: current prose contains specialist definitions, but final broad-audience review is pending.
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: No separate plain-language-summary requirement was located.

requirement: An identified manuscript contains author names and affiliations; primary affiliation is the institution where most work was done, with current address optional.
evidence_to_prove: Author-approved title page, affiliation mapping, corresponding-author contact, and current addresses where applicable.
current_project_status: PARTIAL: names, affiliations, email, and ORCID metadata are present; final author verification is pending.
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: Double-anonymous instructions do not apply to the fixed identified-submission decision.

requirement: Initial submission includes a manuscript file and cover letter; Supplementary Information is optional; PDF, Word, and TeX/LaTeX are accepted initially without special formatting.
evidence_to_prove: Submission inventory containing one authoritative manuscript file and a cover letter.
current_project_status: OPEN: manuscript/R0_NatHealth is absent.
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: The separate initial-formatting page confirms PDF, Word, or TeX/LaTeX; final AIP requirements differ.

requirement: Cover letter explains the work's importance and fit for the diverse Nature Health readership, discloses related manuscripts, and states any prior discussion with a Nature Health editor.
evidence_to_prove: Final author-approved cover letter with significance, fit, related-work, and prior-contact statements.
current_project_status: OPEN
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: Reviewer suggestions or exclusions are optional, and the cover letter is not sent to reviewers.

requirement: Related material under consideration or in press must be disclosed, uploaded as a clearly marked copy, and highlighted in the cover letter; later related submissions must also be reported.
evidence_to_prove: Related placement-manuscript copy, status/date record, overlap/distinction statement, and cover-letter disclosure.
current_project_status: OPEN: the placement manuscript is known but not staged.
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: The journal-level Editorial Policies page also says a copy and progress details must be sent if related work is submitted elsewhere during consideration.

requirement: Preprints are allowed and should be disclosed with DOI and licence; a paper under review without a public preprint should not appear as a numbered reference.
evidence_to_prove: Final live status/DOI check, bibliography scan, and cover-letter disclosure.
current_project_status: OPEN: companion-paper public-preprint status requires final preflight.
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: The no-numbered-reference rule for under-review work without a preprint appears on the AIP references page.

requirement: Final manuscript source must be Word or TeX/LaTeX; PDF is not accepted as the final manuscript source.
evidence_to_prove: Authoritative DOCX that opens cleanly and agrees with the review PDF.
current_project_status: OPEN
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: Initial submission does accept PDF, so the two stages must not be conflated.

requirement: Tables are placed at the end of the text document; complex tables may be separate Excel files; statistical table legends describe standards of error analysis and ranges.
evidence_to_prove: Final DOCX table-location inspection and table/legend inventory.
current_project_status: NOT_VERIFIED
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: No separate main-table count exists beyond the six combined display-item limit.

requirement: Figures are cited sequentially, maximum 180 mm wide, bitmap panels are at least 300 dpi, text is editable 5-7 pt sans serif, original-research artwork is RGB, and line art is supplied as editable vector AI, EPS, or PDF.
evidence_to_prove: Per-figure format, colour-mode, dimension, resolution, font-size, editability, and rendered-page inspection.
current_project_status: NOT_VERIFIED
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: The journal AIP page gives the same 180 mm, 300 dpi, and 5-7 pt core specifications; PNG/JPG/TIFF are not authoritative vector formats for charts.

requirement: Each legend has a brief title, describes panels in order, identifies centre and error values and calculation, sample size, statistical test, and P values, and avoids unnecessary methodological detail.
evidence_to_prove: Legend-to-output audit using exact analytical n and repeated-measure unit.
current_project_status: NOT_VERIFIED
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: No separate legend word limit is stated; figure legends are excluded from the 4000-word main-text limit.

requirement: No more than ten Extended Data display items are permitted; each is cited and fits on a single PDF page.

current_project_status: NOT_VERIFIED
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: The preparation page says ten display items, while the AIP page says ten Extended Data figures; use a conservative combined limit of ten figures and tables.

requirement: Supplementary text, figures, simple tables, and legends are submitted in a single combined PDF; items use separate sequential numbering, are cited in sequence, and each Supplementary Figure plus legend fits one page.
evidence_to_prove: Final combined SI PDF, item/citation-order validation, and visual page inspection.
current_project_status: OPEN
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: Large tables or data may instead be Excel or CSV; Supplementary Information is published as supplied.

requirement: Statistical source data should be supplied in Excel, one file per relevant figure, with the linked figure identified.
evidence_to_prove: One journal-facing XLSX per main and Extended Data figure, reconciled to exact tracked CSV producers.
current_project_status: OPEN
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: The page first says source data are encouraged and then says statistics source data should be Excel; it is not framed as an explicit initial-submission must.

requirement: Research in life, clinical, behavioural/social, and environmental sciences selected for review must provide a completed Nature Portfolio Reporting Summary, which is published with accepted papers.
evidence_to_prove: Completed interactive PDF reconciled to exact sample sizes, repeat-measure structure, tests, covariates, multiplicity, uncertainty, ethics, and sex/gender reporting.

requirement: All original research manuscripts include a Data Availability statement describing access to the minimum dataset, identifiers, and restrictions; supporting data must be available to editors and reviewers on request.

evidence_to_prove: Versioned repository or release, access and licence details, and exact end-matter section placement.

requirement: A code/software checklist and review materials are required when newly developed code or software is central to the paper's main claims.

current_project_status: OPEN/CONDITIONAL
stale_or_inconsistent_page_notes: Central analysis scripts require Code Availability, but may not trigger this checklist unless new software/code is itself a central contribution.
